name: birim-private-files
description: Share protected WordPress files from Claude: find a file, create an expiring link that needs an email code, email it, list and turn off links, and read the download log. Needs the Birim Private Files Pro WordPress plugin.

mcp_url.title: Your site's MCP address
mcp_url.description: The connector address your WordPress OAuth plugin shows, for example https://example.com/wp-json/mcp/mcp-oauth-server. You approve the connection on your site the first time Claude uses it.
